Class Invoice

java.lang.Object
entities.Invoice
public class Invoice extends Object
Invoice entity Represents an invoice with details about a purchase. Contains information such as the purchaser's name, purchase date, session ID, total spend, total tax, and an optional PDF representation of the invoice.
